description: This file defines the QuickLaunchDao class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing quick launch shortcuts related to leave and time modules within the dashboard. It includes methods to retrieve configured shortcuts based on active modules and system configurations.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling quick launch shortcut configurations based on active modules and system settings.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of shortcuts for the admin dashboard, including leave and time modules if active.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchListForESS
methods.description: Returns a list of shortcuts for Employee Self Service (ESS), focusing on leave and time shortcuts based on active modules.

methods.name: getActiveQuickLaunchModuleList
methods.description: Determines which modules (leave, time) are active and configured for quick launch, based on database entries and system configuration.
